title: Asahina Mafuyu — In A Silent Library〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One week before Valentine's Day
Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Just one week left until Valentine's Day.
We're in the final stretch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mizuki's apparently going over to the sewing lounge again today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that means we'll get to work as a group again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How are your gifts coming along?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm just about done with the embroidery on mine.
I just have to shape them into pouches now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You work fast, Kiritani.
I still have quite a lot left to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You also have to make your home ec project, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, but I'm already finished with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
And I have you to thank, Hinomori.
I really appreciate the help you've given me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, don't thank me...
You were the one who put in the work, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean you can focus on your gifts for Valentine's Day now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, it does.
But only when I take breaks from studying.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You've been working in the library, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, because it's so quiet. Embroidering has been a nice way for me to take my mind off of things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm running out of time, so I'll need to pick up the pace now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best together!
Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (That's one finished.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I can keep this up, I should have everything ready by Valentine's Day.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Next, I think I'll work on Miku's handkerchief...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Uh oh... I forgot how to do this part...
Sorry, Shizuku, but would you mind showing me again?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... So that's where you are? I see. So now, you need to use a different stitch...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I think I'll go with a finer gradation here.
Yeah, that should make it look a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (They're all working so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Who we're giving gifts to?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I was wondering where our gifts were going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mine are going to the other members of my group and our manager. Them, and some senior idols who have been helping us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, this is a golden opportunity for us to show our appreciation for them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're able to lead fulfilling lives as idols because of their help and support.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. I can tell that they mean quite a lot to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What about you, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The others in my group...
And a few other friends who mean a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They've been a huge source of support, and I really can't thank them enough for that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes... I'm sure they're going to love your gifts.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Showing appreciation for those who mean the most to you...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Embroidery, huh... Yes, a gift does tend to feel more special when you know it's handmade.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right? This is just how I feel, but I believe quite a lot of emotion goes into every stitch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A lot of emotion...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The process of choosing the right design for the person you have in mind, and carefully stitching it in, really allows you to channel in your emotions.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why, for those truly special occasions, I almost always give people things that I embroidered myself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Everyone's putting their feelings for the recipients into their gifts...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So, for Miku's handkerchief...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I should try thanking her through each stitch...)
